Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MA.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.14 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
We generated $5.6 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 7% to 23% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 7% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
